text:
maria (PM): Heads up — ACME wants a private staged rollout for their on‑prem hub. Targeting customer pilot week of May 18. They require VPC peering, KMS/HSM integration, and a capacity headroom of ~4x peak they reported. Can we triage constraints and launch criteria?

samir (Runtime): Quick q — which model family are they using? Large decoder (8B) or something custom? That affects quantization and KV cache strategy.

maria (PM): They want our 'redwood-8b-quant' variant initially. They said latency SLO 95p < 250ms for short prompts, throughput ~180 rps during peak.

oliver (Infra): 180 rps at 95p 250ms is going to need dedicated GPUs + batching tuning. Need to know expected sequence length distribution and concurrency pattern. Also: do we provision Dedicated pool in their VPC or route through a Private deployment in their subnet?

kevin (Security): From security side: KMS + HSM yes, must support customer BYOK. Audit logs retention 1y. SCIM for user provisioning. We'll need a compliance checklist and at least one design review with infra. Are there regulatory constraints?

maria (PM): ACME is in healthcare, so HIPAA constraints apply. BYOK + private control plane preferred. They want no egress to public internet for model artifacts.

anya (Eng): Work we foresee: private control plane config, bootstrap scripts for model artifacts import, canary rollout hooks, health checks, and test harness. Est: 3 dev sprints + infra prep. Need dedicated ticket for prefix/KV cache warmup and a small QA corpus for quality regression checks.

samir (Runtime): Adds: we should enable prefix caching for common onboarding prompts and set dynamic batching windows. Also propose a fallback policy: if latency > 250ms, route to a smaller quantized variant (redwood-4b-fast) with downgraded quality but maintained SLA.

oliver (Infra): Ops items: open firewall rules, set up peering, allocate GPUs (A10G or H100?), persistent storage encryption, setup node pool autoscaler with cap. Also schedule maintenance window — per ACME they'll accept early-morning windows. I'll estimate 5 infra days for provisioning and testing.

kevin (Security): Checklist items: BYOK integration, audit log stream to customer SIEM, VPC flow logs, encryption in transit, penetration test sign-off. I'll need design doc and threat model before we grant prod access.

maria (PM): Okay — to align, propose the following gating criteria for pilot launch: 1) Private control plane up with VPC peering; 2) BYOK + KMS test pass; 3) 95p latency < 250ms for 90% of synthetic QA prompts; 4) Canary at 5% traffic with rollback plan; 5) Security sign-off. Thoughts?

anya (Eng): LGTM. Add item: automated regression checks against seeded prompt set (quality threshold). We'll need a small human review for initial canary.

samir (Runtime): I'll own canary rollout config and fallback policy. Suggested canary config snippet:```
canary: {
  percentage: 5,
  metrics: ["95p_latency","error_rate","quality_regression"],
  thresholds: {"95p_latency":250, "error_rate":0.01, "quality_regression":0.02},
  rollout_step_minutes: 30
}
```

oliver (Infra): I can provision an isolated dedicated pool and attach customers' VPC via peering. Q: do we use shared infra with network isolation or fully customer-dedicated hardware? Dedicated hardware adds lead time.

maria (PM): ACME prefers customer-dedicated if lead time < 3 weeks, otherwise shared with strict network isolation. Please flag which path adds more risk.

oliver (Infra): Dedicated hardware = +10 business days procurement/testing. Shared + isolation = faster (~3-5 days) but we need strict isolation controls and customer approval.

kevin (Security): Security risk higher for shared hardware. We can mitigate with strong tenant isolation and attestation. Will need legal to approve the risk acceptance for shared path.

anya (Eng): If we go shared, we can front-load software isolation: namespace-level mTLS, storage encryption keys scoped per-tenant, kernel hardening. Still more testing work.

maria (PM): Decision tree for PM/Eng/Infra: 1) If ACME accepts 3-week lead time, go dedicated hardware. 2) Else shared with isolation + legal signoff. I'll loop in legal.

samir (Runtime): Action items: I'll create a runtime checklist (quantization profile, KV warmup plan, canary config) by EOD.

oliver (Infra): Action: I'll spin up a staging peered environment today (deploy-bot will report). Alloc ETA 72h for basic setup.

deploy-bot: staging cluster "acme-staging" created in us-west-2.

kevin (Security): I'll draft the security design template and schedule a design review for Fri.

maria (PM): Thanks all — I'll capture these as the launch requirements and circulate a one‑pager to ACME. Keeping this thread as the single source of truth for cross-team deps. :white_check_mark:

anya (Eng): Quick question — do we have a QA prompt set from ACME or should we seed one?

maria (PM): ACME will provide some walkthrough prompts; we'll supplement with our standard privacy/healthcare prompts. I'll attach in the ticket.

oliver (Infra): Noted. I'll open infra ticket INF-4321 and link here.

samir (Runtime): I'm adding runtime ticket RNT-2106.

kevin (Security): Sec ticket SEC-8720 open for BYOK & audit log work.

maria (PM): Great — target next sync Thurs for readiness check. If any blockers pop up, ping me or drop in #eng-oncall. :pray:
